scope: Load status, fallback content, delay, naming and authored parts of the web component in happy-dom, the React renderer in react-dom/server (node:test), their anatomy and state parity, and the resolver. Rendered sizes are covered by the browser geometry check; image decoding, visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: image and fallback parts, initials and icon, naming, load / error status with data-loading / data-error and loadingstatuschange, delay, authored parts; the resolver
SSR anatomy and classes against the web component, state parity, compound parts against the preset, render and className functions

limitations: Geometry review (manual, 2026-11-02): size, initials font, line height, icon and radius checked in apps/studio/geometry-check.html at every size × B 0 and 1 for sm, md, lg and xl; growth: the box is fixed (n·u) and never shrinks in a flex row (flex-shrink 0), long names give at most two initials, an authored long fallback is clipped by the round frame; RTL: nothing to mirror (initials keep their order); focus: not focusable; light and dark screenshots of the Display family (ladder 3, 4, 6 and the theme unit) and the Home page dashboard, article, landing and settings avatars.
Image loading is simulated with load and error events in happy-dom; real decoding is seen in the browser only.
React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html compares the React Avatar with ui-avatar at five sizes ("fails": []).
The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.
